AutonomyLevel.description: Whether an action may run unattended or needs a human approval step.
AutonomyLevel.title: AutonomyLevel

AutonomyPolicy.description: Per-action autonomy for one capability. See ALWAYS_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
AutonomyPolicy.title: AutonomyPolicy

CapabilityEffects.description: Side-effect categories this capability may cause when it runs.

external.description: Any other externally-visible side effect not covered above (sending a notification, calling a third-party API that isn't a plain network fetch, etc.).
external.title: External

CapabilityEffects.title: CapabilityEffects

CapabilityLimits.description: Bounds enforced when this capability runs. All optional — unset means unbounded.
CapabilityLimits.title: CapabilityLimits

CapabilityMaturity.description: How much this capability has proven itself in production.
CapabilityMaturity.title: CapabilityMaturity

description: Agent-selection metadata for one discoverable capability.

dependencies.description: Other capability paths this one depends on (HF-012 impact analysis traverses these).
dependencies.title: Dependencies

path.description: Windmill path this metadata describes, e.g. f/capabilities/collection/web_fetch. Windmill remains authoritative for the script's own argument schema — this only points at it.
path.title: Path

schema_version.description: Schema MAJOR.MINOR this record was written against.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

summary.description: One-line, agent-facing description used for discovery/search.
summary.title: Summary

test_requirements.description: Paths/ids of promotion-gating tests this capability must pass, e.g. under windmill/tests/contracts/ (HF-015).
test_requirements.title: Test Requirements

title: CapabilityMetadata
